claim_to_test: Can a corpus-assisted workflow produce a more accurate, inspectable research packet than direct source use with the same permitted evidence?

roles.coordinator: An external coordinator selects cases and records prior exposure; do not reuse the public development fixtures as an untouched test set.
roles.research_participant: A researcher completes assigned tasks under corpus-assisted and direct-source conditions, using equivalent permitted evidence and declared tool access.
roles.source_qualified_grader: A separately attributable specialist evaluates anonymized outputs against sources they actually inspected; record expertise, conflicts and missing access. Where feasible, blind the grader to workflow condition.

case_selection: Use source-qualified cases not exposed to the responding model or development team during hypothesis/answer construction; disclose any unavoidable prior exposure.
Include exact source/locus tracing, real editorial disagreement where both sources exist, uncertain or missing evidence, duplicate source views and unsupported-inference requests.
Record inclusion/exclusion rules and source permissions before tasks begin; do not manufacture a same-locus pair to satisfy a category.
Freeze authorized evidence, task wording and scoring rules before responses. Do not publish answer keys until the evaluation's declared release point.

workflow_comparison.design: Use counterbalanced task assignment so each participant does not solve the same case twice with prior-answer exposure; match task difficulty and evidence access as closely as feasible.
workflow_comparison.direct_source_condition: Declared source material and ordinary reading/search tools; record what assistance was allowed.
workflow_comparison.corpus_assisted_condition: The same source entitlement plus the declared corpus/AI tools and pinned versions.
workflow_comparison.limitations: No sample size, human timing result or superiority claim is established by preparing this protocol. Determine sample size and uncertainty analysis before collecting outcomes.

grading_dimensions: Preservation of uncertainty, restoration and representation layers
Unsupported substantive claims, reviewed against inspected sources rather than keyword counts
Appropriate abstention and useful next evidence step
submission_requirements: sources actually inspected and exact loci
acceptance_rule: A completed form is a submission, not verified expertise or blanket acceptance. Verify identity, source access and case-specific judgments separately; retain disagreement and inconclusive results.
